title: 第6章 沈老夫人(1)
content_zh:
初秋，北地大雁排成一行，自辽远长空划过，飞向温暖的南国。院子里夏日繁茂的枝叶都开始凋零，池塘的彩鱼看着都比往日清冷几分。
少女乌黑的长发梳成一个缕鹿髻，插着一支精巧的珊瑚钗，一身深红色挑丝双窠云雁装，勾勒出窈窕玲珑的身材。
白露把锻绣披风轻轻的披在沈妙身上，道：“姑娘病还未好，仔细莫要着凉。”
沈妙摇了摇头。
她身量还小，没得沈玥和沈清高挑，脸儿又生的圆圆，加之平日里怯懦的性格，倒像比实际年纪还要小上几岁，刚刚十一二岁的模样。
但今日却又有些不同。
霜降在一边看着看着，心中有些异样。
少女肤色偏白，看着小小娇娇的一个人，如今脸上一丝笑意也无，说不上冷漠，也说不上憨傻，便是有些冷淡的，却似乎有些怀念的看着天空。还是如以前一样站着，却又有些端庄，仿佛一夜之间不知道从哪里来了独特的气质，竟有几分雍容大气的感觉。
霜降摇了摇头，仿佛这样就能挥走心中荒唐的念头，她笑着看向沈妙：“姑娘在看什么呢？”
自用过早饭后，沈妙便一直站在院子里看着天空出神。
(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
“只是在想，这些大雁从北地飞到南国，是否也经过西北的荒漠。”沈妙轻声道。
西北荒漠，那是沈信镇守的地方，沈夫人和沈大少爷都在此处。上个月送来的家书里称，京城才刚刚寒凉，西北已经百草枯折，小雪渐生了。
“姑娘是想老爷和夫人了吧，”霜降笑道：“等年关老爷就回来了，介时看到姑娘又长高了，不知道有多欢喜。”
沈妙笑了笑，嘴角有些发苦。
一年一度才能回定京的大将军，归来后的第一件事便是面对自家女儿不知廉耻，自奔为妻的笑话，甚至以死逼嫁，能有多欢喜？
更何况她心心念念要嫁的，还是个不过想利用沈家兵权夺嫡的小人。夺嫡鱼龙混杂，沈家本不愿搀和，偏偏被她盲目的爱情拉下了水，最后落得一个满门覆灭的凄惨结局。
沈妙闭了闭眼。
不过短短半年时间，足以发生太多事情。自从她及笄以后，她的婚事，便成为东院随时可以拿捏的把柄。似乎也是从这年及笄开始，东院仿佛卸下伪装的恶兽，一步一步把她逼入了死胡同，回不了头。
“姑娘，姑娘？”白露见小主子神情有异，抓着披风的指尖关节泛白，不由得轻声唤道。

沈妙回过神来，见谷雨小跑着过来道：“姑娘，荣景堂那边的过来催了。”
荣景堂，沈老夫人住的地方，一大早老夫人便差身边的丫头来看沈妙，见沈妙无碍，只说是身子好了就能去给老夫人请安。事实上是请安还是兴师问罪，哪个不是心知肚明？
沈妙微微一笑，紧了紧披风，道：“走吧。”
沈府里，东院和西院泾渭分明。
当初沈老将军在世时，常在西院一片空院子里舞剑打拳，后来沈老将军去世，沈贵和沈万都走文臣之路，独有沈信一人接了老将军的衣钵，那片空院子连着西院一起给了沈信。东院宽大，住了大房二房和沈老夫人三家人。
content_en:
In early autumn, wild geese in the north line up in a row, crossing the distant sky and flying towards the warm south. The lush summer branches and leaves in the yard have begun to wither, and the colorful fish in the pond look a little cooler than before.
The girl's long black hair was combed into a deer bun with a delicate coral hairpin inserted into it. She wore a dark red silk double-cupped cloud goose outfit, which outlined her graceful and exquisite figure.
Bai Lu gently put the embroidered cloak on Shen Miao and said, "The girl is not cured yet, so be careful not to catch a cold."
Shen Miao shook her head.
She is still small, not as tall as Shen Yue and Shen Qing, and her face is round and round. Coupled with her usual timid character, she seems to be several years younger than her actual age, just eleven or twelve years old.
But today there is something different.
Shuang Sheng watched from the side, feeling a little strange in his heart.
The girl's complexion was fair. Looking at the petite person, there was no smile on her face. She couldn't be said to be indifferent, nor could she be said to be stupid. She was just a little cold, but she seemed to be looking at the sky with some nostalgia. Still standing as before, but somewhat dignified, as if a unique temperament came from nowhere overnight, and he actually felt a bit graceful.
Shuang Jiang shook her head, as if this could get rid of the absurd thoughts in her heart, she smiled and looked at Shen Miao: "What are you looking at, girl?"
After having breakfast, Shen Miao had been standing in the yard looking at the sky in trance.

"I was just wondering whether these wild geese flying from the north to the south also pass through the northwest desert." Shen Miao said softly.
The northwest desert was where Shen Xin was guarding. Madam Shen and Young Master Shen were both here. The letter sent home last month said that it was just getting cold in the capital, but the grass in the northwest was already drying up, and light snow was starting to fall.
"The girl misses the master and his wife," Shuangjiang said with a smile, "The master will be back at the end of the year. I don't know how happy I am to see that the girl has grown taller again."
Shen Miao smiled, the corner of her mouth was a little bitter.
The general who only returns to Dingjing once a year, the first thing he does when he comes back is to face the joke of his own daughter who is shameless and wants to be his own wife, and even forces her to marry him at the risk of death. How happy can he be?
What's more, the person she really wanted to marry was a villain who just wanted to use the Shen family's military power to seize the legitimate heir. The Shen family was unwilling to get involved in the chaos of competing for the right to have their legitimate children, but they were dragged into the water by her blind love, and finally ended up with a tragic ending in which the whole family was destroyed.
Shen Miao closed her eyes.
But in just half a year, too many things have happened. Ever since she got pregnant, her marriage has become something that Dongyuan can manipulate at any time. It seemed that starting from the beginning of this year, Dongyuan seemed to have taken off its disguise as an evil beast, forcing her step by step into a dead end, from which she could not look back.
"Girl, girl?" Bai Lu couldn't help but call softly when she saw the little master's expression was different and the knuckles on his fingertips holding the cloak turned white.
Shen Miao came back to her senses and saw Gu Yu trotting over and said: "Miss, the one from Rongjing Hall is here to hurry you up."
Rongjing Hall, where Old Madam Shen lived, early in the morning the old Madam sent the girl next to her to see Shen Miao. Seeing that Shen Miao was fine, she only said that she was well and could go and pay her respects to the Old Madam. In fact, whether it is to ask for peace or to ask for punishment, which one is not clear?
Shen Miao smiled slightly, tightened her cloak and said, "Let's go."
In Shen Mansion, the east courtyard and the west courtyard are clearly separated.
When Old General Shen was still alive, he often danced with swords and boxed in an empty courtyard in the West Courtyard. Later, General Shen passed away and both Shen Gui and Shen Wan followed the path of civil servants. Only Shen Xin took up the mantle of the old General. The empty courtyard was given to Shen Xin along with the West Courtyard. The east courtyard is spacious and houses the second bedroom of the big house and Mrs. Shen's family.
